name: zfmv_action_play_mci_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: zFMV_ActionPlayMci::ScalarDeletingDestructor calls the PlayMci destructor, optionally deletes self for flags bit 0, and returns self.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayMci/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463bf0 validates the thiscall scalar deleting destructor shape: call zFMV_ActionPlayMci::Destructor, test flags bit 0, call operator delete on self only when set, and return self with callee cleanup for the flags argument.
The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_ActionPlayMci::Destructor is covered by the paired functional target and operator delete is a CRT provider boundary.

The native smoke verifies flags=0 leaves self allocated while still running the destructor, flags=1 calls operator delete on self, both paths return self, and owned media/playback fields are released through the destructor.
